Robert Barron says celibacy sets the priest apart as a symbol of the world to come. (CNN) -- The scandal involving the Rev. Alberto Cuté has raised questions about the Catholic Church's stance on priestly celibacy. Why does the Church uphold a practice seeming unnatural? A flawed argument claims married life is spiritually inferior, demanding priests remain unmarried to maintain moral superiority. This reasoning contradicts core Christian teachings. Scripture affirms creation's goodness (Genesis 1:31). Catholic theology rejects dualism, affirming material reality's inherent value. Creation's finitude necessitates recognizing God's transcendence over all earthly things. The First Commandment (Exodus 20:3) forbids idolizing lesser realities. Detachment requires refusing to center one's life on anything less than God. While embracing life's beauty, we must keep it in proper perspective. The Church's liturgical richness contrasts with monastic simplicity, reflecting this balance. Regarding sexuality, the Church celebrates marriage while advocating celibacy as a prophetic witness to eternal communion. Celibates embody the love we'll experience in heaven, where relationships surpass earthly bonds. As Chesterton observed, this creates necessary tension. Celibacy's ultimate purpose points beyond this world. Greeley noted priests' mystique derives partly from celibacy's otherworldliness. These views remain the author's alone.

article_content: Property developer Janet Brown, who disappeared in 2005 without claiming her £1 million inheritance, remains the focus of an intensified police investigation. Northumbria Police have conducted repeated searches at Plane Trees Farm near her Northumberland home over 18 months, while also pursuing leads in Spain, Italy, and Thailand. Financial irregularities involving her deceased parents' accounts and her untouched assets have led to fraud charges against a 57-year-old man and 63-year-old woman. Friends report growing belief she was murdered, noting her unused passports and banking inactivity. Investigators continue seeking information about her whereabouts, emphasizing the case's unresolved nature.

article_content: A renowned Kurdish female commander, Hebun Sinya (also known as Hebun Dêrik), who led an all-women YPJ unit against ISIS in Kobane, is reported killed during the group's final assault on the city. The YPJ, a women-only militia under the YPG, became pivotal in defending Kobane since ISIS first attacked in September 2014. Though Kurdish forces expelled ISIS from Kobane in late January 2015, YPG/YPJ confirmed Sinya died alongside three comrades—Ywan Zaghrws (a male fighter) and two unidentified individuals—in the final push. Sinya featured prominently in YPG/YPJ propaganda to galvanize resistance amid a four-month siege where ISIS nearly overran the city, committing atrocities in surrounding areas. Reinforcements from Iraqi peshmerga aided the counteroffensive, pushing ISIS into isolated pockets by early 2015. The YPJ’s presence psychologically undermined ISIS fighters, who reportedly feared losing divine rewards for dying at women’s hands—a tactic noted by U.S. House International Relations Committee Chair Ed Royce in September 2014. Despite liberation, Kobane lies in ruins, with most residents displaced. While Kurdish victories highlight gender equality and combat effectiveness, geopolitical tensions with Turkey and Syria complicate long-term stability. Over 200,000 displaced civilians await safe return as coalition support remains critical to preventing ISIS resurgence.

article_content: Kevin Wang's passion for education led him to found TEALS (Technology Education and Literacy in Schools) in 2009. After earning his electrical engineering degree from UC-Berkeley in 2002, he prioritized teaching over corporate roles before balancing Microsoft's software development work with pre-dawn high school CS instruction. This grassroots effort evolved into a national initiative placing tech professionals as part-time educators in 35 schools across seven states, now expanding to New York City. Supported by Microsoft's YouthSpark program, TEALS tackles both the shortage of qualified CS teachers and the tech industry's need for skilled workers. With starting salaries averaging $64,400 (reaching nearly $100,000 at top firms), computer science graduates still fall short of filling 150,000 annual job openings. Only 0.69% of all high school AP exams are in CS, underscoring limited course availability despite its growing relevance across industries. Wang advocates making CS a core requirement alongside traditional sciences, noting its critical role in fields from biology to finance. While progress remains slow - Utah had just 61 AP CS test-takers in 2012 - TEALS' NYC expansion reflects rising urgency. Partnering with schools and leveraging tech professionals' flexibility, the program trains volunteers to deliver standardized curricula. Success stories like aspiring game developer Adrian Chavez highlight the initiative's impact. Despite challenges, Wang emphasizes that even small improvements represent significant progress toward preparing students for 21st-century careers.

article_content: Craig Hignett resigned immediately as Middlesbrough's assistant manager following a post-match confrontation with head coach Aitor Karanka. The dispute stemmed from Karanka's dismissal by referee Mark Clattenburg during Saturday's 1-1 draw with Blackburn, which occurred after a controversial 95th-minute equaliser involving Chris Brown's challenge on goalkeeper Dimi Konstantopoulos. The FA charged Karanka with misconduct, with reports indicating he pushed the fourth official during protests. Tensions escalated further as Karanka accused Hignett of insufficient support during the incident. Despite recent mutual praise on BBC's Football Focus - where Hignett highlighted Karanka's reliance on his expertise - the duo's private rift led to Hignett's exit. Middlesbrough acknowledged his contributions since joining from Hartlepool in 2023. Karanka apologized for his behavior but lambasted officials' oversight of the 'blatant' foul on Konstantopoulos, questioning how the incident went unnoticed by match officials. The result left Boro two points adrift of Championship promotion contention in fifth place.

Το συμβούλιο απευθύνει έκκληση για περισσότερους ειδικούς νοσηλευτές, ενσωμάτωση εθελοντικών οργανώσεων και πρόσβαση στα πιο πρόσφατα μόρια διαγνωστικά. Ο καρκίνος του πάνκρεατος προκαλεί 2.000 θανάτους ετησίως στο Ουαλία, αν και το κυβερνήματος αναγνωρίζει βελτίωση της επιβίωσης των τελευταίων δεκαετιών.

article_content: Ένας ηγέτης του Συμβουλίου της Φλίντσερφ (Sir y Fflint) κάλεσε για αύξηση των νομιμών περιοχών για τα πληθυσμούς των Γκιψί και των Τραβελερ στα βόρεια Ουαλία, υπογραμμίζοντας την έλλειψη διαθέσιμων πόρων. Ο Μπέρνι Άττριττζε μνείασε ότι 95% των νομιμών περιοχών βρίσκονται στη Φλίντσερφ και τη Βρεξάμ, ενώ άλλα περιφερειακά συμβούλια κρίθηκαν αδιάφορα για την ανάγκη μεταρρυθμίσεων. Η συνεργασία μεταξύ Κόνουϊ, Δενμπίτς, Γουίνετ και Υνίς Μόν για την εκτίμηση των ανάγκων των κοινοτήτων προχωράει. Το σύμβουλο της Φλίντσερφ σκέπτεται την επέκταση της περιοχής στο Κβινςφεργι τοποθετώντας μετακίνηση προσωρινών ομάδων. Οι Υνίς Μόν επιτρέπουν μόνο προσωρινές μένες, ενώ οι Δενμπίτς δεν έχουν επιχειρήσει να δημιουργήσουν διαρκείς λειτουργίες. Η κυβέρνηση της Ουαλίας εκτιμά ότι 4.000 Γκιψί και Τραβελερ ζουν στην περιοχή, αναγκάζοντας τους υπουργεία να αναλάβουν συστηματικές επιχειρήσεις.

The Welsh Government estimates 4,000 Gypsies/Travellers reside in Wales, emphasizing the need for systemic policy reforms.

article_content: Ο οικονομολόγος Γέρι Χόλθαμ φωνάζει για αμέσω αναδιοργάνωση του συστήματος τελών κοινοβουλίων στη Ουαλία, δηλώνοντας ότι τα τελώνα επιβαρύνουν περισσότερο τους ιδιοκτήτες μικρών οικοδομιών. Προτείνει μεταφορά του συστήματος σε βάση τιμής κτιρίου (0.9%), υπογραμμίζοντας ανίσοτητες: μια οικία 50.000 £ πληρώνει 1.5% (800 £/χρόνο), ενώ μια 500.000 £ πληρώνει μόλις 0.5% (2.500 £). Αυτή η μεταρρύθμιση μπορεί να δημιουργήσει εξοχώς 20 εκατομμύρια £ ετήσια. Το κυβερνήματος της Ουαλίας αρνείται αλλαγές τα πρώτα 3-5 χρόνια αλλά αναφέρει δυνατότητες μεταρρύθμισης με τη μελλοντική διαχείριση εξουσιών τελών. Ο Χόλθαμ επισημαίνει ότι το τελώ του κτιρίου αποτελεί αξιόλογο φόρο της πλούτου, αντίστοιχα με τους φόρους εργασίας που εμποδίζουν τις απασχόλησης. Τα τελώνα κοινοβουλίων δεν ανανεώνονται από το 2005 στην Ουαλία και το 1992 στην Αγγλία.
translated_content: Economist Gerry Holtham is urging immediate reform of Wales' council tax system, arguing current rates disproportionately burden smaller homeowners. Proposing a shift to property-value-based taxation at 0.9%, he highlights stark disparities: a £50k home pays over 1.5% annually (£800), while a £500k home pays under 0.5% (£2,500). This reform could generate £20m annual savings. While the Welsh Government rules out changes within the next 3-5 years, it acknowledges future flexibility via devolved tax powers. Holtham stresses property taxation better targets wealth than income taxes, which can deter work participation. Current tax bands remain frozen since 2005 in Wales and 1992 across England.

translated_content: A group of Ahmadi Muslims have been providing meals and feeding homeless individuals in Cardiff to counteract negative perceptions linked to the Islamic faith. The Muslims gather in Nhetganna, Cardiff, with 35 members demonstrating in central Cardiff and Newport. Exhibitions are also held in church halls and streets to address 'misconceptions about Islam'. Originating in Northern India in the 19th century, Ahmadi Muslims are considered non-Muslim by mainstream communities due to their belief that Muhammad wasn't the final prophet. With fewer than 150 Ahmadi Muslims in Wales, their population in Pakistan declines due to persecution over doctrinal differences. Nassir Domun, regional coordinator of the Ahmadiyya Muslim Youth Society, notes 35 volunteers assisted in feeding the homeless overnight. He emphasized: 'Our core duty is to care for our community. We must show empathy and compassion across all faiths.' The week-long initiatives culminate in a multi-faith peace conference in Cardiff.

Rydym hefyd wedi atgoffa staff bod angen y caniatâd priodol i dynnu lluniau o staff, ymwelwyr neu gleifion.' Dywedodd Mr Whittle: 'Rwy'n hapus iawn bod y bwrdd iechyd wedi gweithredu'n gyflym.'
translated_content: Health officials acted following complaints that staff had posted derogatory comments and images on Facebook of an elderly patient in the same ward. The case involved staff at Nevill Hall Hospital in the Vale of Glamorgan. The Aneurin Bevan Health Board reminded staff of its policy requiring explicit consent to take photos of staff, visitors, or patients. Officials also placed posters in the hospital and considered additional measures to protect patient privacy. Lindsay Whittle, the Member of Parliament for East Carmarthenshire, criticized taking photos on mobile phones in hospitals as unacceptable. In September, the hospital confirmed it was investigating a complaint that photos taken in the hospital had appeared on Facebook. The patient’s family, who is in their 70s, viewed the page. The page displayed two patients in beds facing each other with the caption: 'She is the one on the left.' Sources stated the patient was upset that her photos were taken without consent and that a series of abusive comments under the photos were 'derogatory.' At the time, a spokesperson for the Aneurin Bevan Health Board said the board had acted and removed the page from the website. The spokesperson added: 'The health board recognizes its duty of care to ensure the privacy and dignity of patients and staff are protected at all times. We have also reminded staff that explicit consent is required to take photos of staff, visitors, or patients.' Mr. Whittle said, 'I’m very pleased the health board acted swiftly.'

article_content: Mae'r newyddiadurwr a chyn olygydd Y Cymro Glyn Evans wedi farw yn oed 70 ar ôl salwch byr. Er ei fod yn ymddeol, roedd yn parhau yn weithredol - yn ysgrifennu blog ac yn gyfrifol am Yr Enfys. Disgrifiodd Gwilym Owen ei effaith fel 'newyddiadurwr arbennig', nodi ei dyfodiant i lythyr a'i dadleuon syml. Roedd yn 'godwr bora mawr' a daeth yn gytûn yn gweithio hyd at 6:00 bore. Dywedodd Sian Gwynedd o BBC Cymru ei fod yn 'adolygydd praff' gyda chyfraniad allweddol i Y Cymro. Roedd yn ŵr gweddw a gadael tri phlentyn.
translated_content: The journalist and critic Glyn Evans of Y Cymro has passed away at 70 following a brief illness. Originally from Anglesey, he spent much of his life in Ruthin, Denbighshire. Mr. Evans worked for BBC online services and the Herald Cymraeg throughout his lengthy successful career. Though retired, he remained active - writing a blog and overseeing Yr Enfys publication. Colleague Gwilym Owen described him as an 'exceptional journalist', highlighting his storytelling flair and dedication. A 'coffee enthusiast', he often worked until 6am. BBC Wales' Sian Gwynedd praised his 'keen critical perspective' and vital contributions to Y Cymro. He leaves behind three children. #RestInPeaceGlyn #WelshJournalismLegacy

article_content: Mae Cadair Eisteddfod Genedlaethol Sir Ddinbych a'r Cyffiniau wedi ei chyflwyno i Bwyllgor Gwaith y Brifwyl yn digwyddiad arbennig yn Arthog, Dolgellau. Rhoddir y Gadair eleni am awdl neu gyfres o gerddi mewn cynghanedd gyflawn heb dros 250 llinell ar thema 'Lleisiau'. Y beirniaid yw Gerallt Lloyd Owen, Peredur Lynch a Myrddin ap Dafydd. Dilwyn Jones o Faerdy, Sir Ddinbych, wedi'i greu. Dywedodd ei fod yn credu bod angen i gadair adlewyrchu dalgyrch y Brifwyl fel ddathliad parhaol. Mae wedi cael ei gynrychioli gan dderw a breichiau sy'n nodi gwarchod treftadaethau lleol. Cyflwynwyd gan Gerallt a Dewi Hughes er cof i'w rhieni. John Glyn Jones, cadeirydd pwyllgor 2013, nodwyodd bod y Gadair yn bwysig i'r brosiect cymunedol a bod disgwyl 'lleisiau' Cymraeg yn cael eu gwrando yn ystod y Eisteddfod.
translated_content: The National Eisteddfod Chair of Meirionnydd and Dyfi Valley was unveiled at a special ceremony in Arthog, Dolgellau to the Festival Management Board. This year's design features poems or poetic series in strict meter (under 250 lines) centered on the theme 'Voices/Languages'. Judges Gerallt Lloyd Owen, Peredur Lynch, and Myrddin ap Dafydd selected the winner. Created by local craftsman Dilwyn Jones of Faerdy, the pine-wood chair reflects the region's natural beauty from coast to mountains, with carvings emphasizing cultural preservation. Dedicated by brothers Geraint & Dewi Hughes in honor of their late parents. Event organizer John Glyn Jones noted the chair symbolizes two years of work bringing the Eisteddfod to the area, hoping it will inspire Welsh-language conversations across communities. The crowning ceremony takes place on August 9th at 4:30 PM.

article_content: Fe fydd seremoni wobrwyo Llyfr y Flwyddyn yn cael ei chynnal yng Nghaernarfon eleni. Yn Galeri yn ardal Doc Fictoria nos Iau, Gorffennaf 10, fe fydd Llenyddiaeth Cymru'n datgelu pa deitlau ar y rhestrau byrion Cymraeg a Saesneg a gaiff eu henwi'n Llyfr y Flwyddyn 2014. Yn y seremoni fe gyhoeddir enillwyr y categorïau Barddoniaeth, Ffuglen a Ffeithiol Greadigol yn Gymraeg ac yn Saesneg, a pha lyfrau sy'n cipio'r teitlau Llyfr y Flwyddyn Cymraeg 2014, a Llyfr y Flwyddyn Saesneg 2014. Bydd enillydd pob categori yn derbyn siec o £2,000, a'r prif enillydd ym mhob iaith yn derbyn gwobr o £6,000 ychwanegol. Caiff enillydd y categori Barddoniaeth yn Saesneg ei enwi yn enillydd y Roland Mathias Poetry Award. Ar y panel Cymraeg mae'r awdur ac enillydd Llyfr y Flwyddyn 2008, Gareth Miles, y bardd Eurig Salisbury, a'r awdur a'r blogiwr Lowri Cooke. Ar y panel Saesneg mae'r darlithydd Andrew Webb, yr awdur a'r newyddiadurwr Jasper Rees, a'r comedïwr Nadia Kamil. Caiff rhestr o naw llyfr Cymraeg a naw llyfr Saesneg ei chyhoeddi trwy ddarllediad ar-lein arbennig ar y cyd â'r rhaglen gelfyddydau Pethe, ddydd Gwener Mai 9, a gellir ei wylio'n fyw ar wefan Llyfr y Flwyddyn. Dywedodd Lleucu Siencyn, Prif Weithredwr Llenyddiaeth Cymru: 'Mae Llenyddiaeth Cymru yn hynod falch fod un o ganolfannau diwylliant pwysig Cymru yn gartref newydd i Seremoni Wobrwyo Llyfr y Flwyddyn eleni. Mae'n hollbwysig fod Llyfr y Flwyddyn yn cael ei gweld fel gwobr i ddarllenwyr Cymru gyfan, ac mae'r newid hwn o gael Seremoni Wobrwyo teithiol yn gam ychwanegol tuag at y nod hwnnw.'
translated_content: The annual Book of the Year awards ceremony will take place in Caernarfon this year. On Thursday, November 10th, at the Galeri Arts Centre in Doc Fictoria, Literature Wales will announce the shortlisted titles for the Welsh and English categories selected as Book of the Year 2014. During the ceremony, winners of the Poetry, Fiction, and Popular Factual categories in both languages will be revealed, along with the recipients of the 2014 Welsh Book of the Year and English Book of the Year titles. Each category winner receives a £2,000 prize, while the top winner in each language gets an additional £6,000 grant. The English Poetry category winner will also be awarded the Roland Mathias Poetry Prize. The Welsh judging panel includes 2008 Book of the Year winner Gareth Miles, poet Eurig Salisbury, and author/blogger Lowri Cooke. The English panel features lecturer Andrew Webb, author/journalist Jasper Rees, and comedian Nadia Kamil. A list of nine Welsh and nine English shortlisted books will be unveiled via a dedicated online broadcast alongside the Pethe entertainment show on Friday, May 9th, and can be streamed live on the Book of the Year website. Lleucu Siencyn, CEO of Literature Wales, stated: 'We’re thrilled that one of Wales’ key cultural venues is now hosting the Book of the Year Awards. It’s essential the Book of the Year remains a cherished award for all Welsh readers, and holding the ceremony in a touring format strengthens this mission.'
